title: mc's vanilla+
description: vanilla+ (no changes to vanilla behaviour). Mostly performance and qol client side mods.
body:
vanilla+ by nawty

- no changes to normal vanilla mechanics
- performance mods
- few quality of life mods (proximity voice, waypoints, etc)

used for my own minecraft server. feel free to use for yourself.

works both on single player / servers. every mod is clientside. careful with freecam on public servers. full mods list below :)
